'''Chocolate''' is the simple preparation of [[Cocoa Beans|cocoa beans]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/chocolate.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Cocoa beans roast into chocolate in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up cocoa beans unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating chocolate takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Haste I for 0:30.

Obtaining chocolate unlocks the [[Chocolate Chip Cookie|chocolate chip cookie]] and the [[brownie]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
